title: smime-tree: VerificationResult and SignerResult are missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: error.rs: VerificationResult { signers: Vec<SignerResult> } and SignerResult { verified, subject, error } are public structs without #[non_exhaustive]. Adding fields in a future release (e.g. SignerResult::cert_subject_key_id or VerificationResult::cms_version) will be breaking for callers who destructure the structs. Since both types are result types in a public API for a security-sensitive operation, they should be #[non_exhaustive] to allow adding diagnostic fields without a major version bump.
